summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of the PV validation and locking feature. All 13 test cases passed successfully. The feature correctly implements: 1) 'Valider le PV et les resultats' button (replacing old 'Signer & Valider le PV'), 2) Confirmation dialog with 3 actions listed, 3) Green banner and 'Modifier le PV et resultats' button after validation, 4) Decision dropdowns become static badges when locked, 5) Saisie des notes tab shows locked banner and disabled save button, 6) Unlock functionality restores editability, 7) Diplomas tab shows warning when bulletins not published.

minor.issue: Console shows 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 400' when navigating to diplomas - may be a query issue but doesn't affect functionality

seed_data_creation: PV was validated and unlocked during testing for Semestre 1 period
context_for_next_testing_agent: PV validation feature is fully functional. The Rh formation has 3 students (Bernard Lucas 10.50, Dubois Alice 13.00, Petit Emma 14.00) all marked 'Admis'. The evaluation_periods table has is_locked, locked_at, locked_by columns. When PV is validated: JuryDeliberation shows green banner + 'Modifier le PV et resultats' button + static badges. GradeSheetView shows amber locked banner + disabled save button. DiplomaManagement checks allBulletinsPublished before enabling generate button.

tests_executed.test: 1. Login admin, go to notes-admin > Rh > Gérer les notes > Jury & Délibération tab
tests_executed.details: Successfully logged in as admin.principal@nectforma-demo.com and navigated to Jury & Délibération tab

tests_executed.test: 2. Verify 'Valider le PV et les resultats' button is visible (NOT 'Signer & Valider le PV')
tests_executed.details: Button found with data-testid='validate-pv-btn' and text 'Valider le PV et les resultats'

tests_executed.test: 3. Verify 3 students are shown with decisions (Admis) that can be changed via dropdown
tests_executed.details: 3 students shown: Bernard Lucas (10.50, Passable, 3ème, Admis), Dubois Alice (13.00, Assez bien, 2ème, Admis), Petit Emma (14.00, Bien, 1er, Admis). Decision dropdowns are editable.

tests_executed.test: 4. Click 'Valider le PV et les resultats' - verify confirmation dialog appears with 3 actions listed
tests_executed.details: Confirmation dialog appeared with title 'Valider le PV et les resultats' and 3 actions: 1) Enregistrer les decisions du jury pour 3 etudiant(s), 2) Verrouiller la saisie des notes pour cette periode, 3) Generer les releves de notes

tests_executed.test: 5. Click 'Valider' in the dialog - verify success toast 'PV et resultats valides'
tests_executed.details: Success toast 'PV et resultats valides avec succes' appeared after clicking confirm button

tests_executed.test: 6. After validation: verify banner turns green with 'PV et resultats valides' badge
tests_executed.details: Green banner (bg-emerald-600) appeared with 'PV et resultats valides' badge and validation timestamp

tests_executed.test: 7. After validation: verify 'Modifier le PV et resultats' button replaces the validate button
tests_executed.details: Button with data-testid='unlock-pv-btn' appeared with text 'Modifier le PV et resultats'

tests_executed.test: 8. After validation: verify decision dropdowns become static badges (not editable)
tests_executed.details: Decision dropdowns (data-testid='decision-select-*') are no longer visible - replaced by static 'Admis' badges

tests_executed.test: 9. Switch to 'Saisie des notes' tab - verify locked banner appears
tests_executed.details: Amber locked banner appeared: 'PV et resultats valides — la saisie est verrouillee. Pour modifier, deverrouillez dans l'onglet Jury & Deliberation.'

tests_executed.test: 10. In Saisie des notes: verify save button says 'PV valide (verrouille)' and is disabled
tests_executed.details: Save button shows 'PV valide (verrouille)' and is disabled. 'Verrouille' badge appears next to 'Semestre 1'

tests_executed.test: 11. Go back to Jury tab, click 'Modifier le PV et resultats' - verify it unlocks
tests_executed.details: Clicked unlock button, toast 'PV et resultats deverrouilles — vous pouvez modifier les notes' appeared. Validate button reappeared.

tests_executed.test: 12. After unlock: verify saisie des notes is editable again
tests_executed.details: Locked banner is gone, 'Enregistrer' button is enabled, grade inputs are editable

tests_executed.test: 13. Go to Diplomas tab > Rh > Gérer les diplômes - verify warning about bulletins not published
tests_executed.details: Warning banner visible: 'Les bulletins de notes doivent etre publies avant de generer les diplomes'. Generate button is disabled with tooltip explaining the requirement.
